basic_info.description: Majestic Victorian Duplex with a Huge Top 2 Level Flat and a Large Full Floor Flat. Top Two Levels has 3 Bedroom use with Living Room, Formal Dining Room, Laundry Closet, Chef's Kitchen and updated 1 and 1/2 baths. Top Level of this flat has spacious family room, and Primary Suite with updated bathroom. First Floor Flat has modern finishes with 3 Bedrooms, Laundry Room, One and 1/2 updated bathrooms, and Open Concept Designer Style Kitchen, Living Room, and Formal Dining. Large Basement for Storage and Landscaped Garden / Yard complete this massive building. Also offered as Tenancy in Commons.
